green_enterprise_page.title: Green for Enterprises & SAMRS Projects | ELVOSOLAR a.s.
green_enterprise_page.hero_desc: An overview of subsidy opportunities for Slovak enterprises under European structural funds and the presentation of our development activities abroad under SlovakAid.
green_enterprise_page.stat4_label: Expected launch of the subsidy project
green_enterprise_page.siea_p1: The Slovak Innovation and Energy Agency (SIEA) is preparing to implement a national project aimed at supporting the use of renewable energy sources in enterprises ("Green for Enterprises") under the Slovakia Program 2021 – 2027. SIEA published the document "De minimis aid scheme for the national project Green for Enterprises", which regulates the details of the entire project.
green_enterprise_page.siea_p2: Through the upcoming pilot project Green for Enterprises, micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises have the opportunity to obtain a financial contribution of up to 50,000 euros. The contribution is intended for the elaboration of energy audits and the installation of suitable equipment for the use of renewable energy sources.
green_enterprise_page.siea_p3: The following text summarizes the information that has been made available by SIEA so far, although some rules may still be subject to change.
green_enterprise_page.siea_p4: According to the available information, the exact date for opening the application system has not yet been determined. However, SIEA claims that it wants to simplify the entire process as much as possible and make it accessible to all entrepreneurs. The good news is that SIEA will not limit the location of the business entity within Slovakia, which would mean opportunities for enterprises in the Bratislava region as well.
green_enterprise_page.advantages_title: Advantages of the Green for Enterprises Project
green_enterprise_page.adv1_desc: The basic condition is to have an energy audit compiled, which will determine the RES potential and determine the optimal size of the installation. It is not necessary to select specific devices or contractors in advance from a list, which allows applicants to contact any supplier.
green_enterprise_page.adv2_desc: You can cooperate directly with us without administrative obstacles or restrictive registries of contractors.
green_enterprise_page.applicants_title: Entities eligible to apply for a subsidy
green_enterprise_page.applicants_desc: According to the information, applicants are micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises ("SMEs") operating in any sector (except agriculture). Therefore, any entity performing economic activity regardless of its legal form is classified under SMEs. This includes in particular:
green_enterprise_page.applicants_li3: Partnerships and associations with economic activity
green_enterprise_page.applicants_li4: Energy communities (in accordance with § 11a of Act No. 251/2012 Z. z.)
green_enterprise_page.msp_limits_title: Limitations and definition of SMEs under Annex No. 1 of the de minimis aid scheme:
green_enterprise_page.support_level_desc: Support is set at 40% of eligible expenditures. An additional 5% can be obtained for equipment utilizing at least 80% of the produced heat, cold, and electricity directly in the enterprise, with the maximum subsidy amount reaching up to €50,000.
green_enterprise_page.additions_desc: In addition to the photovoltaic panels themselves, it should also be possible to draw contributions for other system components, e.g.:
green_enterprise_page.additions_li2: Smart management system for production and consumption (i.e. inverter and other electronics)
green_enterprise_page.partnership_message: Our company Elvosolar, a.s., will gladly assist you with your entire photovoltaic project.
green_enterprise_page.step1_desc: Elaboration of an energy audit (EA) prior to submitting the actual application for the contribution. This is an essential part of the application for the voucher. The EA must be purposefully focused on the form of energy to be replaced by RES.
green_enterprise_page.step1_desc2: The EA is an eligible expenditure and, in the event of approval of the application, up to 45% of its price will be reimbursed (the total subsidy for technological equipment is subsequently reduced by this value of the reimbursed EA).
green_enterprise_page.step1_note: * The list of energy auditors is published on the SIEA website. Our company Elvosolar, a.s. will assist you with selecting an energy auditor already at this stage.
green_enterprise_page.step2_desc: Submitting the application for voucher issuance takes place in the SIEA information system. In addition to the EA itself, qualification as an SME and a declaration of received de minimis aid over the last 3 fiscal years are required. Subsequently, SIEA verifies the conditions, approves them, and a Voucher Provision Agreement is signed.
green_enterprise_page.step3_desc: After signing and the contract taking effect, a 6-month period for complete installation of the equipment begins. Our planners will gladly inspect the installation site in advance to design the fastest installation process.
green_enterprise_page.step4_desc: Reimbursement of the voucher is requested only after completing the installation. Subsequently, an inspection is performed by SIEA to verify compliance with the EA. After approval, SIEA sends the funds directly to the applicant's account. The voucher is reimbursed only after full realization of the project.
green_enterprise_page.limits_desc: The main limit is the maximum contribution amount per SME of €50,000. Equipment for electricity generation is limited to a total installed capacity of 250 kW. A maximum contribution amount per installed kW is also specified to verify cost-effectiveness.
green_enterprise_page.sidebar_li1: Early audit (EA): Contact SIEA or directly Elvosolar, a.s. for timely processing of the audit.
green_enterprise_page.sidebar_li2: Agreeing terms: We will inspect the site, propose exact conditions, and prepare a quote.
green_enterprise_page.sidebar_li3: Monitoring calls: With us, you will immediately know about the application opening for timely submission.
green_enterprise_page.sidebar_form_subtitle: Are you interested in a quote or detailed consultations? Contact us.

samrs.kenya_title: Deployment of photovoltaic-powered ESS and microgrids / off-grid for power supply and grid stabilization as a replacement for diesel generators
samrs.kenya_desc1: The project's objective is market analysis and presentation of solar solutions that represent reliable, affordable, and above all, fast solutions to electricity shortages, especially in remoter provinces of the country, and establishing partnerships that the company can utilize in project execution. In cooperation with the Export-Import Bank of the Slovak Republic (Eximbanka SR), which provides tied aid to low-income countries, the company will be able to offer and execute high-quality and efficient projects at half the investment cost.
samrs.kenya_desc2: Kenya represents great potential in the energy sector, especially in the field of renewable sources. Historically in Kenya, most electricity is produced from hydroelectric plants (35%), geothermal energy represents 28%, and thermal power plants 31% (mostly coal). Electricity demand is growing steadily and Kenya is expected to require up to 6,700 MW of electricity in 2024 for its own consumption alone. Despite progress made in recent years, securing energy for a population of over 49 million remains on the lower end compared to developed countries.
samrs.kenya_impact1: Raising awareness of renewable energy sources and energy efficiency
samrs.kenya_impact2: Reducing energy costs and reducing CO2 greenhouse gas emissions
samrs.kenya_impact4: Increasing ecological and self-sufficient solutions utilizing RES
samrs.kenya_desc3: The project results will represent not only a significant step in the use of modern ecological technologies, but also an important innovative step for Slovakia. The applicant will place high emphasis on sustainability of project results even after the subsidy ends. Activities are aligned to eliminate risks of unsustainability. Training of local experts guarantees long-term sustainability.
samrs.afg_title: Renewable and Clean Energy Training Center in Kabul
samrs.afg_desc1: Education is the primary prerequisite for country development and stability. Demand for vocational training in Afghanistan in recent years is immense, but the quality of education has been and remains affected by a lack of technical equipment and trained staff.
samrs.afg_desc2: The purpose of this project is training and qualification of working-age individuals in the field of renewable energy through technical equipment and facilities, human potential development, building cooperation between Slovak and Afghan institutions, and transfer of knowledge and know-how from Slovakia.
samrs.afg_desc3: Project execution will create a modern, fully-equipped training center aimed at providing practical training in solar systems along with trained personnel. In the first phase of the project, Afghan lecturers will be trained, who will subsequently conduct training directly at the project site in Kabul.
samrs.afg_target: Main objective: Increase the depth of knowledge and skills of technical staff in the energy sector, increase efficiency and maintenance of solar energy systems, as well as general awareness of solar systems.

absorption_page.title: Absorption Cooling | ELVOSOLAR a.s.
absorption_page.lead_text: The demand for cooling production currently has a rising trend, making it essential to start using technologies capable of producing this commodity from renewable or waste sources.
absorption_page.desc_p1: Cooling production by absorption units uses waste heat from industrial or non-industrial processes as an energy source, significantly reducing electricity consumption compared to conventional cooling production.
absorption_page.desc_p2: The Thermax units we design and offer provide absorption cooling technology from 35 kW to 12,000 kW of cooling capacity, with the energy source being heat obtained from hot water, steam, oil, gas combustion, exhaust gases, or flue gases.
absorption_page.more_info_p1: Absorption is a chemical process where a gaseous compound is dissolved or absorbed in a liquid (absorbent). Leveraging this principle, cooling can be technologically produced.
absorption_page.more_info_p2: Absorption systems use thermal energy to produce a cooling effect. Unusable (waste) heat can therefore be used as an energy source to produce cooling. In these systems, water (refrigerant) absorbs heat at a lower temperature and lower pressure during evaporation and releases heat at a higher temperature and higher pressure during condensation.
absorption_page.more_info_p3: The absorbent (in this case, LiBr solution) absorbs refrigerant vapors in the low-pressure section of the system and releases them in the high-pressure section after heating. For heating and subsequently separating the absorbent from the refrigerant, waste heat (e.g., from industrial processes) is utilized. The released refrigerant vapors enter the condenser where they condense. Partially cooled liquid refrigerant is then released under high pressure back into the evaporator space (low-pressure section of the system). This change in pressure results in a significant change in the temperature of the liquid refrigerant, which subsequently evaporates in the evaporator, cooling the chilled water used for cooling the selected space.
absorption_page.more_info_p4: In the **ProChill (twin design)** absorption machine, hot water first passes through a high-pressure generator and then through a low-pressure generator, significantly increasing the cycle efficiency.
absorption_page.advantages_title: Advantages of Absorption Units over Compressor Units:
absorption_page.adv_li1: The main energy sources are hot water, steam, flue gases, exhaust gases, waste gas, or waste heat.
absorption_page.adv_li2: They use only **5% of electrical energy** for operation compared to traditional compressor chillers.
absorption_page.adv_li3: Very quiet, maintenance-free, and highly reliable operation.
absorption_page.adv_li4: Devices are eco-friendly with minimal self-consumption of energy.
absorption_page.adv_li5: The equipment features high efficiency for heat recovery.
absorption_page.adv_li6: The system can be used simultaneously for cooling and heating (using cooling water from the condensation process).
absorption_page.adv_li7: Very fast return on investment (approximately **4 years** despite the higher purchase price).
absorption_page.specs_p1: The Thermax units we design and offer provide absorption cooling technology from **35 kW to 12,000 kW** of cooling with a high COP coefficient of up to **1.8**.
absorption_page.specs_p2: Thermax chillers are custom-built for manufacturing processes with accredited certificates ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 18001. Thermax absorption chillers have all international certificates, and all units are tested for nominal operating performance directly at the Thermax manufacturing facility prior to installation.
absorption_page.references_desc: Low operating costs, simple and safe technology. Absorption cooling represents an eco-friendly and economical way to produce cooling from waste heat.
absorption_page.app1_desc: Industrial plants, manufacturing facilities, food factories, chemical plants... with the possibility of processing waste heat from hot water, steam, gas, oil, exhaust gases, or flue gases.
absorption_page.app2_desc: Energy production from renewable sources, heating plants, compressor stations... with the possibility of processing waste heat from hot water, steam, or gas.
absorption_page.app3_desc: Farms, dairies... with the possibility of processing waste heat from hot water, steam, or gas.
absorption_page.app4_desc: Wellness centers, water parks, shopping centers... with the possibility of processing waste heat from hot water or steam.

battery_page.title: Battery Storage | ELVOSOLAR a.s.
battery_page.lead_text: Storing produced electrical energy is key to its efficient use. Battery storage systems (ESS) represent a critical pillar of modern renewable energy sources.
battery_page.desc_p1: They allow for reliable accumulation of unused electrical energy generated by photovoltaic panels during the day, so it can be utilized during peak hours, at night, or during sudden grid outages (backup/UPS functionality).
battery_page.desc_p2: Our company offers customized design, construction, and maintenance of reliable battery storage systems for residential homes, industrial facilities, agriculture, and commercial sectors.
battery_page.advantages_desc: Modern lithium battery systems (especially LiFePO4 technology) feature an outstanding lifespan of over 6,000 charging cycles and high operational safety. A properly designed storage system eliminates the need to feedback solar excess to the grid under disadvantageous terms, and successfully stabilizes the local consumer grid.
battery_page.benefits_li1: Independence: Backup of key electrical circuits during distribution grid failures.
battery_page.benefits_li2: Cost savings: Maximize the utilization of your self-produced solar energy instead of purchasing from the utility.
battery_page.benefits_li3: Intelligent management: Seamless, real-time energy flow management and peak demand suppression (Peak Shaving).
battery_page.app1_desc: Smart-controlled energy storage solutions for residential houses.
battery_page.app2_desc: Peak demand suppression (peak-shaving) and reducing reserved capacity and costs for companies.
